evidence.capture: enemies alive at full health, no progression logged

reasons: System START and enemy SPAWN are observable and error-free, but the oracle's required PROGRESSION (a wave clearing, next wave beginning, or a state transition) was NEVER observed in the ~50s window — logs stayed frozen at the spawn point (cursor=7).
Wave-clear depends on player combat killing enemies; the brutes never closed distance to the player and no Humanoid.Died fired, so no lifecycle advancement past spawn could be confirmed.
Skeptic rule: cannot PASS on START+SPAWN alone when the stated progression criterion is unmet; the unmanned playtest did NOT reproduce the ORACLE's claimed clear-to-VICTORY behavior.

steps: Authored config-driven wave table (count/health/walkSpeed/ringRadius per wave)
Spawn ring places enemies around arena center; ring tightens each wave
Wave-clear detected via Humanoid.Died decrementing alive count
VICTORY printed after final wave; all lifecycle events tagged [Siege]

recipe.text: Config-driven RoundLoop-family system: Config.Waves lists escalating waves. runSiege waits for a player, then per wave prints START, spawns brutes on a tightening spawn ring (staggered), and each brute chases the nearest player so combat happens. Enemies die ONLY from real player damage via Humanoid.Died, which decrements the alive count; at 0 the wave fires CLEARED. After the last wave it prints VICTORY. All events log with the [Siege] tag; no auto-kill/test hook.
